node.statement: Cornerwise scope calculation. Let x lie in the source (j,k)-corner. Validated node 1.1.1 gives gamma(x)=gamma_jk(x) and places x^dagger in the (k,j)-corner, so gamma(x^dagger)=gamma_kj(x^dagger). Hence tilde_gamma(x)=[gamma_jk(x)+gamma_kj(x^dagger)^dagger]/2 and tilde_gamma(x)-gamma_jk(x)=[gamma_kj(x^dagger)^dagger-gamma_jk(x)]/2. The datum bounds the norm of the latter numerator by rho||x|| but does not make it zero. Therefore ||tilde_gamma(x)-gamma_jk(x)||<=rho||x||/2, while equality tilde_gamma|_{S_{Pi_j,Pi_k}}=gamma_jk does not follow. The validated symmetrization children consequently establish only a nearby extended isomorphism; they cannot establish that the prescribed raw assembly gamma is an extended isomorphism. This also removes the apparent conflict with 1.4.1.2.1: that child blocks only the raw-gamma definitional inference, whereas 1.4.1.2.2--1.4.1.2.4 concern a different map.
